question: Which of the following Airport become 1st airport in India to be run entirely on hydro and solar energy?

options.text: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai

solution:
The correct answer is __Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport has become the first airport in the country to run entirely on hydro and solar power from June 2022.
 
• This is part of the airport’s goal to achieve the ‘Net Zero Carbon Emissions Airport’ target by the year 2030.
 
• In 2015, the Cochin International Airport in Kerala became the first airport in the world to run solely using solar energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Important Current Affairs related to Airport:​ 

 
 
• Qatar's Hamad International Airport has been named the World’s Best Airport for the year 2022.
 
• The Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru has bagged the best regional airport in India and South Asia title in the 2022 Skytrax World Airport Awards.
 
• The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai has launched a Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT) and Solar PV hybrid (Solar Mill).
 
• With this, It will become the first airport in India to launch a one-of-its-kind hybrid power project.
 
• Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport has decided to replace all vehicles with electric vehicles (EVs) on the airside operations to cut greenhouse gas emissions.
